debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output. Set to true only when troubleshooting.

server.description: Canna server runtime and network configuration.

bindings.description: Network addresses and ports the server listens on.

address.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0).

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before an idle client session is terminated.

client_mem_limit.description: Maximum memory (in KB) a single client session may use.

persistent_sessions.description: Persist session state across reconnections (e.g., user dictionaries).

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to log to stdout.

default_locale.description: Default locale for new sessions (e.g., ja_JP.eucJP, ja_JP.UTF-8).

kanji_code.description: Default kanji encoding for I/O: euc, sjis, jis, or utf8.

dict_update_perm.description: Who may update dictionaries: 0=none, 1=admin only, 2=all users.

shm_dir.description: Directory for shared memory segments (must be owned by canna user).

dictionaries.description: List of dictionary names (without path or extension) to load at startup.

allowed_hosts.description: List of hostnames/IPs explicitly allowed to connect.

items.description: Fully qualified domain name or IP address.
